notes.title: The Heart of Darkness Trading Cards and More!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413990/The_Heart_of_Darkness/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/72b6149ffabb30ff209645980c11139a2fa0878b.jpg[/img][/url]

We're excited to announce that we have enabled Steam Community Items for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413990/The_Heart_of_Darkness/][i]The Heart of Darkness[/i][/url] which means you can now collect trading cards, backgrounds, emotes, and badges of your favorite characters!

All you have to do is load up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413990/The_Heart_of_Darkness/][i]The Heart of Darkness[/i][/url] and start playing for a chance to receive a drop!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413990/The_Heart_of_Darkness/

Once again we want to thank you for all of your support and we hope you'll enjoy our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Kagura/list/38286]upcoming releases[/url]!
